findings.passage: “We are a month away from a major election, and there is mounting evidence that voting and voter registration has become chaotic and complicated by design. I wholeheartedly disagree with the Voter ID law, and this rule does nothing to fix the major problem: that Wisconsin’s Voter ID law is a ‘wretched failure.’”
findings.note: Press release he issued (then as a state representative) after a legislative committee extended an emergency rule on voter ID and DOT-issued IDs. Posted by Urban Milwaukee as a submitted release. Month taken from the original Senate-site URL slug 10-04-16, which now returns 404.

findings.passage: Wisconsin has discouraged our residents from voting by making it far too difficult through the Voter ID law.
findings.note: Same 2016 release: describes the voter ID law as making voting too hard and says claims of voter fraud were used to build support for it.

findings.passage: Isolated instances of individuals committing voter fraud are referred for prosecution after every election, and every credible review of Wisconsin elections has demonstrated they do not have systemic vulnerabilities.
findings.note: Official Assembly press release in his name about a video of a person submitting fraudulent mail or online ballot requests; says it is a crime to request another voter's ballot and that Wisconsin elections are secure.
